approach.mechanism: The address change kills the TCP connection. The app detects it (OS notification, or a stall timeout), opens a new connection from the new address and resumes the session with its own sequence numbers (HELLO carries the next needed seq).
approach.name: TCP reconnection baseline
approach.recovery_point: first new (non-duplicate) data frame delivered to the mobile node on the NEW connection
approach.scope_limits: Needs an application that implements resume; an unmodified TCP application simply loses its connection.
approach.status: No mobility protocol. Application-level behaviour over TCP (RFC 9293). In the emulator TCP is the simplified TcpLite model; the same application logic is validated over real kernel TCP on loopback.

support: TcpLite transport model + shared application logic
